Sewage Advisory: Crews respond to sewage release in SE Portland

Label:
News article

On Monday, March 2, City crews responded to a sewage release near 1234 SE Example St in Southeast Portland.

Published
March 2, 2026 4:00 pm

Around 1:15 p.m. on March 2, City crews responded to a reported sewage release from a maintenance hole at 1234 SE Example St. An estimated 300 gallons was released to Example Creek.

If you experience or see a sewer overflow, contact the City's hotline at 503-555-0100.

Help prevent sewage releases

Only flush human waste and toilet paper.
